title: Biquad Filter
text: Model biquadratic IIR (SOS) filters, 4 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Scale values} sets Scale values; {Coefficient source} sets the mode of operation, {Filter} sets the name of filter, {Filter structure}, {SOS Matrix (Mx6)} sets the sOS matrix, {Initial conditions}, {Initial conditions on zeros side}, {Initial conditions on poles side}, {Scale values mode} sets the mode to specify scale values Specify via input, {Action when the a0 values of the SOS matrix are not one} sets the action when a0 values of SOS matrix are not one, {Optimize unity scale values}, {Input processing}, {View Filter Response}, {Rounding mode}, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Section input}, {Section output}, {Multiplicand}, {Coefficients}, {Product output}, {Accumulator}, {States}, {Output} and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Coefficient source
params.values: Mode of operation Dialog parameters (default) | Input port(s) | Filter object

params.name: Filter
params.values: Name of filter object BQF (default) | dsp.BiquadFilter System object name

params.name: Filter structure
params.values: Filter structure Direct form II transposed (default) | Direct form I | Direct form I transposed | Direct form II

params.name: SOS Matrix (Mx6)
params.values: SOS matrix [1 0.3 0.4 1 0.1 0.2] (default) | M -by-6 matrix

params.name: Scale values
params.values: Scale values 1 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Initial conditions
params.values: Initial conditions 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Initial conditions on zeros side
params.values: Initial conditions on zeros side 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Initial conditions on poles side
params.values: Initial conditions on poles side 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Scale values mode
params.values: Mode to specify scale values Specify via input port (g) (default) | Assume all are unity and optimize

params.name: Action when the a0 values of the SOS matrix are not one
params.values: Action when a0 values of SOS matrix are not one Warning (default) | None | Error

params.name: Optimize unity scale values
params.values: Optimize unity scale values on (default) | off

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Input processing Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: View Filter Response
params.values: View filter response button

params.values: Rounding mode Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.values: Section input data type Same as input (default) | Binary point scaling
